limitations: Topic-selected corpus, not an exhaustive census of all 2024-2026 scientific publications.
All KDD D&B titles were screened; excluded papers did not receive a full-text rejection review.
Downloaded author versions may differ from the final proceedings and from earlier reviewed versions.
Normal OpenReview notes/forum access requires browser verification; public search was used where available.
No direct KDD review threads were retrieved; prior-venue reviews retain their original provenance.
Public-search retrieval does not establish complete coverage of all replies in a forum.
No unpublished/private reviews or synthetic review datasets are used as peer-review evidence.
Focused reading notes do not represent a detailed methods critique of every catalog entry.
